answer_1.quote: Effective automatic generation of functional code from visual designs has the potential to democratize the development of front‑end web applications ...

answer_2.quote: We develop automatic metrics for this task that measure the visual design similarity between the generated webpage's screenshot and the given screenshot input... we use the similarity of their CLIP embedding... we introduce a suite of element‑matching metrics: Block‑Match, Text similarity, Position similarity, Color similarity.

answer_4.quote: We recruited human annotators (paid at the rate of $16/hour) from Prolific, we conducted a series of human evaluations to compare across models and methods... Task Overview... Content Check... Layout Check... Style Check...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to judge which candidate webpage is closer to the reference, first checking content, then layout, then style; also asked whether the AI‑generated page can replace the original and which design is better.
